name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=chapter, descriptor=current_chapter_id). Descriptor clearly conveys the scalar id/index role; no Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching its own/any data address; tail token 'id' is semantic, not an address). Mild repetition of 'chapter' is acceptable and unambiguous.
purpose: Canonical current-chapter engine index: a single 32-bit unsigned scalar that selects the active chapter for resource loads and per-chapter dispatch across the whole game.
logic_summary: Read as an unsigned index for resource loads (FDFIELD.DAT idx=id*3 and id*3+2, FDTXT.DAT idx=id+1) in fd2_load_save_and_init_engine, and for per-chapter dispatch tables in fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher (CALL [id*4+0x51DE9] end-handler, CALL [id*4+0x51D71] init/category, MOVZX [id+0x51E63] per-chapter byte table). Normal chapters occupy 0..0x1D (0-based); chapter-end handlers INC it to advance to the next chapter. fd2_chapter_01_init additionally drives it through the two prologue maps 0x20 then 0x1F before settling on 0 for the chapter-1 main battle. Loaded from save header byte pBuf[0x30C5] on continue, and written into the save record header on save.
element_semantics: Single scalar = current chapter / resource index. Values: 0..0x1D = the 30 normal chapters (0-based), 0x1F and 0x20 = the two chapter-1 prologue maps. Consumed as an unsigned index into per-chapter resource (FDFIELD/FDTXT) and dispatch (end-handler/init/category/byte) tables.
notes: src comment block (chend1.c lines ~983-1003) already accurate/refined/well-evidenced (resource math, dispatch-table addresses, prologue 0x20/0x1F/0 values, zero-init, multi-writer homes) -> kept, no src edit. is_const=false confirmed by many WRITE/READ_WRITE xrefs (fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @0x10147, fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher, fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot, all chapter init/end handlers).
